message: １０％の福

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh-ho? Something's lying on the ground」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Nanaka, what are you doing out here? Oh, I know, you're sunbathing, aren't you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Am not. Look right there, somebody dropped something」

name: Synn
message: 「What could that be? That palm-sized brown cube」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-you can't tell just by looking? It's obviously a wallet」

name: Synn
message: 「No way! You're such a joker, Nanaka. Wallets are way flatter than that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not lying, look!」
Nanaka picked up the mysterious cube and handed it to me. It was hefty, with the feel of well-worn leather.

name: Synn
message: 「I-it really is a wallet, but... what is with this weight and thickness?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's 'cause it's stuffed to the brim with wads of cash」

name: Synn
message: 「W-w-w-wads of cash!? Haugh, my heart...! Dizzyyyy~...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey now, don't faint on me, pull yourself together!」
Nanaka took the terrifying wallet away from me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa-nelly, it's heavy... Sure are a lot of rich girls at Ryuusei Academy, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoever dropped it must be in trouble. I'll go turn it in to the faculty room. Whose is it, though?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? There's a student ID inside... The owner's a third-year」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ubya!? I-it's Bubuzuke's...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, if it belongs to Misasagi-senpai, that makes sense」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The wallet's still warm. She's close by!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let's split up and look--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Inhaaaale--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heeeey, Bubuzukeee!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Square-shouldered Bubuzukeee, who always gets told 'Relax your shoulders~' at the hair salon even when she's already relaxed!!」

name: Synn
message: 「T-that's awful...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heeey, Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here, you dropped your wallet. You owe me one.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Much obliged. Though I'm surprised you're handing it back so obediently.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hehehehe... It's only right to pay the finder a ten percent reward, isn't it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Turning the Wagashi Club's fortune into operating funds for the Sweets Society... Wah-ha-ha-ha! Now this is great!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, I get that you're happy, but calm down. You actually did a good deed, yet you're laughing just like a villain.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Eeny, meeny, miny, moe... Here you are, please accept your ten percent.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nailed it~!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, what the heck is THIS?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It says what it is right there, doesn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, these are tickets for the raffle they're holding in the shopping district right now.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Third-years have plenty of free time, you see, so I'm planning to invite Ria and go spin the raffle drum soon.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yuugiri-an sponsors this thing too, so I've got mountains of these things waiting back home!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, I'll be on my way.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh, and just so we're clear, I'm not being stingy, alright? I just don't carry cash--I make it a policy to shop by card.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, sorry for the intrusion.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hoo-boy, bye-bye... So disappointing...」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is it really something to get that down about? Since we have them, let's go try the raffle.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?! W-With me...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, you're right. Let's go, let's go! Let's go spin it right now!」

name: Synn
message: 「Consolation prize is tissues, 9th prize is soap, and 8th prize is bath salts. How luxurious!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah-ha-ha-ha, Synn, you're such a homemaker. At the very least, we gotta aim for the 7th prize seasoning set.」

name: Paqy
message: 「No, shouldn't we be hoping for the 1st prize pair of hot spring trip tickets?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm good on that. Nanaka and I already took baths together when we were kids, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I don't mind going in right now, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm? Did you say something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's nothing!」
After school that day, with Nanaka cheering me on, I spent my time spinning the raffle drum.
As for the spoils... Well, you can never have too many tissues.
